boxRule: A site is a square of k = sizeM / siteTileSizeM site tiles per axis. With (east, north) the grid metres of the centre (UTM 10N minus the grid origin, packages/core frame.ts), tx0 = round(east / siteTileSizeM - k / 2) and ty0 = round(north / siteTileSizeM - k / 2); tiles tx0 .. tx0 + k - 1 east, ty0 .. ty0 + k - 1 north. Implemented by siteTileBox in packages/pipeline/src/terrain/sites.ts.
